faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Juvenile Justice Board, Dharmapuri (JJB Dharmapuri) to fill vacant positions under its administration in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in JJB Dharmapuri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant, aimed at supporting administrative and office operations effectively.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced across the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by downloading the application form and sending it via post or courier to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form to the designated office is 16-10-2026 by 5:45 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed the SSLC (Class 10) public examination with computer proficiency, and typing certificates in Tamil and English are preferred.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required qualification for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Assistant position must have successfully passed the VIII (Class 8) standard from a recognized school board.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 42 years. Please review the official notification for any applicable age relaxation guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Junior Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates selected for the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent by post or courier to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Old District Collectorate Campus, Dharmapuri District 636 705.
